title: Generic finite splitting over a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism with $Y$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $V\subseteq Y$ be a dense open. There is a dense open $U\subseteq V$ and an etale covering family $(T_i\to U)_i$ such that for every $i$ the fibre product $P_i=T_i\times_U f^{-1}(U)$ [def-pc-fibre-product] has a finite pairwise disjoint open covering $(W_{ij})_{j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n_i)}$, and every composite $W_{ij}\to P_i\to T_i$ is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. The cover and partition are independent of any sheaf. The integer $n_i$ may be zero.

proof.text: In the reduced Noetherian target take all integral affine opens A contained in V. For each A apply exists_dense_open_finite_scheme_splitting to f restricted to A, and use its conclusion on its own dense splitting open D_A. Put B_A equal to the image of D_A in Y, and U equal to the supremum of all B_A. U lies in V. To prove density, for the component C of any x remove all other components, obtaining a nonempty open O with closure C. Intersect O with V and choose a nonempty affine open A therein. A is irreducible and reduced, hence integral. Its closure contains C, and density of D_A implies A is contained in the closure of B_A. Thus x belongs to closure U. This entire argument is the proved private theorem reduced_generic_finite_splitting.

Compose each affine splitting cover T_A -> D_A with the open-image isomorphism D_A -> B_A and the inclusion B_A -> U. These etale maps jointly cover U, defining Cover.mkOfCovers. Paste the pullback squares for f restricted to U and to A, then use isoIsPullback to identify their base-changed sources. The proved helper splitting_partition_iso pulls the partitions across this isomorphism and proves covering, disjointness and universal-homeomorphism properties. Empty targets and empty sources need no separate branch: the index family and partitions can be empty.

For a general Y use its real nilradical subscheme R with inclusion r. Its range is all of Y by range_subschemeiota and support_nilradical, so it is a surjective closed immersion and a homeomorphism. The existing nilradical reducedness instance and isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType give R reduced Noetherian. Pull V back to R and apply the proved reduced theorem to pullback.snd f r. Send its dense open U_0 to Y using the homeomorphism: the image U is open, dense, and contained in V. Injectivity proves r^{-1}(U)=U_0. Now finite_splitting_descends_surjective_closedImmersion supplies the etale cover and partitions of f restricted to U.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_finite_noetherian_scheme_splitting
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : Dense (V : Set Y)) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ Dense (U : Set Y) ∧
      ∃ 𝒯 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage U.toScheme, ∀ i,
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → (pullback (𝒯.f i) (f ∣_ U)).Opens),
          (⨆ j, W j) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun j k ↦ Disjoint (W j) (W k)) ∧
          ∀ j, IsUniversalHomeomorphism
            ((W j).ι ≫ pullback.fst (𝒯.f i) (f ∣_ U))
